scope: Primary-source provenance closure status only. This audit does not change observations, model equations, mappings, fitted parameters, candidate selection, retained trajectories, or scientific claims.

status_scale.PASS: Primary authority and exact retained input lineage are closed to the declared model role, including frozen/hash-verified primary bytes or an equivalently strong deterministic proof.
status_scale.WARNING: Authority and semantics are identified and no material disagreement is known, but full primary transport/hash/value lineage remains incomplete.
status_scale.BLOCKER: A provenance defect prevents the input from being accepted at its current declared scientific role.

evidence_levels.L1: authoritative institution/dataset and scientific role identified
evidence_levels.L2: semantic definition and selected anchor values or boundaries independently reconciled
evidence_levels.L3: exact primary artifact/version/file identified with immutable checksum metadata where the authority exposes it
evidence_levels.L4: complete primary-file-to-retained-input byte/value lineage reproduced and recorded

resolved_documentation_issue.conclusion: Hash difference is fully explained by CRLF-to-LF normalization; model content is unchanged.

sources.authority: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
sources.closure: Clean reproduction fetches the official FAO archive and accepts it only after exact size and SHA-256 verification.

sources.model_role: central observed proxy for World3 Human Welfare Index
sources.authority: United Nations Development Programme, Human Development Report Office
sources.dataset: HDR 2025 all composite indices and components time series (1990-2023)
sources.verified_semantics: UNDP documentation exposes the complete 1990-2023 series; the retained World HDI adapter already matches all eight published World anchors recorded in the 2026-09-21 follow-up.
sources.unresolved: Official CSV bytes are not frozen/hash-pinned in EWD and complete annual World-row equality has not been recorded.
sources.required_action: Freeze or deterministically fetch the official UNDP CSV, record byte hash and size, then compare every World HDI observation used by EWD before any transport replacement.

sources.model_role: population benchmark and plausibility guardrail; not fitted central population target
sources.authority: United Nations, Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Population Division
sources.verified_semantics: UN WPP 2024 defines estimates through 2023 and projections to 2100, and recommends CSV bulk download for advanced use; this matches the EWD estimate/medium-projection boundary.
sources.unresolved: Official bulk-file bytes are not frozen/hash-pinned in EWD and complete World 1950-2100 equality has not been recorded.
sources.required_action: Freeze/hash the official bulk CSV/GZ and compare World total population, both sexes/all ages, including the estimate/medium split, across all retained years.

sources.model_role: energy diagnostic/candidate evidence; not a central calibration target
primary_artifacts: Statistical Review of World Energy Data workbook
sources.current_transport: Pinned GitHub mirror commit recorded in science/data/processed/energy_institute_global_2026.provenance.json
sources.verified_semantics: The official 2026 page exposes the workbook, consolidated narrow CSV, methodology and definitions; the page also warns that historical values may be revised between editions.
sources.unresolved: Independent official-download byte/value equivalence with the pinned mirror transport is not recorded.
sources.required_action: Acquire the official 2026 narrow CSV/workbook, record checksum and size, and compare the seven Total World base variables used by EWD against the pinned transport.

sources.model_role: direct-emissions diagnostic target; not a central World3 state observation
sources.dataset: The Global Carbon Project's fossil CO2 emissions dataset
sources.verified_semantics: The primary Zenodo record exposes the exact 2025v15 file and checksum; the current EWD diagnostic retains coal, oil, gas, cement, flaring and other categories while using coal+oil+gas as its direct-combustion target.
sources.unresolved: A complete direct primary-Zenodo-to-EWD 1990-2024 row/category comparison is not yet captured in current main.
sources.required_action: Reconstruct the compact snapshot directly from the primary Zenodo file and verify all six categories for every retained year before declaring L4 closure.
